newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Central Bank sells 97.00 bln rbls bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russian Central Bank sells 97.00 bln rbls bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank sold 97.00 billion roubles nominal of OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Tuesday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 24011 issue closed on Tuesday at 101.18 percent, and the 24012 issue closed at 100.08 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the Central Bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
Full details of recent central bank transactions in the secondary market for the Finance Ministry can be seen on CBGKOSEC.
